extracted.name: Avocado & cannellini bean dip
extracted.description: Beat hunger pangs with this vegan avocado and cannellini bean dip. Serve with crudités and crackers as a snack, light lunch or as part of a picnic
ingredient_lines: ½ tsp chilli flakes plus extra to serve
3 tbsp avocado oil plus extra for drizzling
mixed seeds crackers or crudités, to serve (optional)
instruction_lines: Scoop the avocado flesh into a blender or small food processor. Add the beans, garlic, spices, lemon zest and juice and oil. Blitz until completely smooth, loosening with 50-100ml water, if needed. Season.
Spoon into a bowl and top with extra chilli flakes and avocado oil. Serve with the seeds scattered over, and crackers or crudités, if you like.
